name: chrome-etc
description: Chrome extension for enhanced GitHub experience

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && npm run copy-static
scripts.copy-static: cp public/manifest.json public/options.html public/icon-*.png dist/ && npm run copy-vendor
scripts.test: npm run test:visual && npm run test:d2 && npm run test:sticky && npm run test:wysiwyg
scripts.test:visual: npm run build && npx ts-node --project tsconfig.test.json test/test-comment-fold-visual.ts
scripts.test:d2: npm run build && npx ts-node --project tsconfig.test.json test/test-d2-visual.ts
scripts.test:sticky: npm run build && npx ts-node --project tsconfig.test.json test/test-sticky-comment-heading.ts
scripts.test:wysiwyg: npm run build && npx ts-node --project tsconfig.test.json test/test-wysiwyg-editor.ts
scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist && zip -r ../extension.zip *
